meanings.usage: 指交通工具，常用英式拼写，美式为airplane

meanings.meaning: 发疯的（形容人的精神状态，也可表示对某事疯狂热衷（be mad about））

meanings.usage: 供飞机起飞、降落、停放的场所
指从某地经过或穿过某物
指不悦耳的声音，常与make, cause等词搭配

meanings.meaning: drive to　开车去往某地

meanings.usage: determine to do something表示决心做某事
表示可能性较大，比maybe更正式
offer sb. something向某人提供某物
knock down意为撞倒；knock at/on敲门

meanings.meaning: a great many + 可数名词复数

phrases.usage: 日以继夜，表示持续不断发生

examples.en: The machines work night and day.
The constant noise drove me mad.
examples.zh: 持续的噪音让我快要发疯了。

examples.en: The new railway came into use last year.
The farmers drove the cows away from the field.
The old building was knocked down last month.
examples.zh: 那栋旧楼上个月被拆除了。

examples.en: He received a large sum of money from his uncle.
examples.zh: 他从他叔叔那里得到了一大笔钱。

examples.en: She is determined to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 她决心按时完成这个项目。

examples.en: For some reason, the meeting was cancelled.
examples.zh: 由于某种原因，会议被取消了。

examples.en: You must be tired after the long journey.
examples.zh: 长途旅行后你一定很累。

examples.en: He is one of the few people who can speak five languages.
examples.zh: 他是少数能说五种语言的人之一。

phrases.usage: /naɪt ænd deɪ/ phrase. 日日夜夜；夜以继日（表示持续不断，强调时间之长）
/kʌm ˈɪntu juːz/ phrase. 开始使用（表示某物被投入使用）
/draɪv əˈweɪ/ phrase. 驱赶；赶走（表示迫使某人离开某地）

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.definition: 表示一个过去的动作对现在造成影响，且主语是动作的承受者 用于强调动作的承受者，或动作执行者不明确/不重要时

examples.en: The airport has come into use.
Over a hundred people must have been driven away.
examples.zh: 肯定有上百人被赶走了。

grammar.title: must表示推测 (Must for Deduction)
grammar.structure: must + 动词原形（对现在推测）；must have + 过去分词（对过去推测）
grammar.definition: must用于肯定句中表示对现在或过去情况的肯定推测 must表示推测时只用于肯定句，否定句用can't，疑问句用can

examples.en: Everybody says I must be mad.
examples.zh: 大家都说我一定是疯了。

examples.en: You must be hungry after working so long.
examples.zh: 工作了这么久你一定饿了。

grammar.title: 现在进行时的被动语态 (Present Continuous Passive)
grammar.definition: 表示正在进行的被动动作 强调正在被进行的动作

examples.en: New houses are being built in this area.
examples.zh: 这个地区正在建造新房子。

original.en: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.

imitations.en: Worry is slowly driving her mad.
The hot weather is driving the tourists mad.
imitations.zh: 炎热的天气快让游客们发疯了。

original.en: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes.
original.zh: 肯定有超过一百人被从家中赶走。

imitations.en: The thief must have been caught by now.
imitations.zh: 小偷现在肯定已经被抓住了。

imitations.en: They must have been informed about the changes.
imitations.zh: 他们一定已经被告知了这些变化。

patterns.pattern: have been offered + something + to do

original.en: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away.
original.zh: 有人给我一大笔钱让我搬走。

imitations.en: She has been offered a good job to work abroad.
imitations.zh: 有人给她提供了一个去国外工作的好职位。

imitations.en: We have been offered a discount to buy the house.
imitations.zh: 有人给我们打了折扣买这房子。

patterns.pattern: be one of the few/only + 名词

original.en: I am one of the few people left.
original.zh: 我是少数留下来的人之一。

imitations.en: She is one of the few students who passed the exam.
imitations.zh: 她是少数通过考试的学生之一。

imitations.en: This is one of the few buildings that survived the war.
imitations.zh: 这是战争后幸存的少数建筑之一。

lines.en: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
lines.zh: 飞机正在逐渐把我逼疯。

lines.en: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.
lines.zh: 我住在一个机场附近，过往飞机日夜不绝于耳。

lines.en: The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then.
lines.zh: 机场是许多年前建的，但由于某种原因当时未能启用。

lines.en: Last year, however, it came into use.
lines.zh: 然而去年机场开始使用了。

lines.en: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise. I am one of the few people left.
lines.zh: 有100多人肯定是被噪音逼得已经弃家远去，我是少数留下来的人中的一个。

lines.en: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
lines.zh: 有时我觉得这房子就要被一架飞过的飞机撞倒。

lines.en: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here.
lines.zh: 他们曾向我提供一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决定留在这儿。

lines.en: Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
lines.zh: 大家都说我肯定是疯了，也许他们说的是对的。

questions.q: Why do people think the writer is mad?
questions.zh: 为什么人们认为作者疯了？
questions.a: Because he has been offered a large sum of money to go away, but he is determined to stay near the airport, where passing planes can be heard night and day.
questions.aZh: 因为有人给他一大笔钱请他搬走，他却决心留在机场旁，那里日夜都能听见过往的飞机声。
questions.hint: 见 I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here 与末句 Everybody says I must be mad。

questions.q: When was the airport built, and why could it not be used then?
questions.zh: 机场是什么时候建的？为什么当时不能使用？
questions.a: It was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then.
questions.aZh: 机场是许多年前建的，但由于某种原因当时未能启用。
questions.hint: 见 The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then。

questions.q: How many people have left their homes because of the noise, and why does the writer say 'must have been'?
questions.zh: 有多少人因噪音离开了家？作者为什么用 must have been？
questions.a: Over a hundred people. He uses 'must have been driven away' because he is making a confident guess about something that happened in the past.
questions.aZh: 一百多人。他用 must have been driven away，是对过去已经发生的事作肯定推测。
questions.hint: 见 Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise。

questions.q: What does the writer fear may happen to his house?
questions.zh: 作者担心他的房子会发生什么事？
questions.a: He sometimes thinks his house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
questions.aZh: 他有时觉得这房子会被一架飞过的飞机撞倒。
questions.hint: 见 Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane，将来时被动 will be + 过去分词。

questions.q: Everybody says the writer must be mad, and he answers 'they are probably right'. Is he really mad?
questions.zh: 大家都说作者肯定疯了，他也说“也许他们说得对”，他真的疯了吗？
questions.a: No. It is self-mockery. Judged by common sense, refusing a large sum of money and staying beside a noisy airport does look mad, but he is simply determined to stay, and 'must be mad' is a confident guess, not 'must' of duty.
questions.aZh: 不是。这是自嘲：拒收巨款、守在噪音不断的机场旁，按常理看确实像疯了，但他只是决心留下；而且 must be mad 里的 must 是“肯定”的推测，不是“必须”。
questions.hint: 联系 I am determined to stay here 与 Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right。

translation:
飞机正在逐渐把我逼疯。
我住在一个机场附近，过往飞机日夜不绝于耳。
机场是许多年前建的，但由于某种原因当时未能启用。
然而去年机场开始使用了。
有100多人肯定是被噪音逼得已经弃家远去，我是少数留下来的人中的一个。
有时我觉得这房子就要被一架飞过的飞机撞倒。
他们曾向我提供一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决定留在这儿。
大家都说我肯定是疯了，也许他们说的是对的。
title: Mad or not?
subtitle: 是疯了还是不疯？

lead.question: 机场就在家门口日夜轰鸣，一百多人搬走了，作者为何偏要留下来？
lead.warmup: 把家安在机场旁边是什么感受？清晨到深夜，过往的飞机从头顶掠过，轰鸣声日夜不息，一百多位邻居已经被噪音逼走。作者却留了下来：有人出一大笔钱请他搬家，他拒绝了，还说自己“决定留在这儿”。旁人于是断言他肯定疯了，他竟回答“也许他们说得对”。读完你会发现，乐趣全在情态动词如何替人下判断。
goals: 复述课文：用英语讲清作者为何拒收巨款、坚持住在机场旁
掌握本课五个被动句式：can be heard、was built、must have been driven away、will be knocked down、have been offered
区分 must be 与 must have been：对现在与对过去的肯定推测
会写 drive sb mad、for some reason、come into use、a large sum of money、be determined to
lead.summary: 本课把被动语态和情态动词捆在一起讲：飞机“被听见”、机场“被建成”、人们“被逼走”、房子“被撞倒”、钱“被提供给作者”，五个被动句式串起了全文。推测用法分两档：说现在用 must be，说过去用 must have been 再接过去分词。另有一处易混：for some reason 里的 some 表“某种”，不表“一些”，后接单数名词。
lead.tips: 易错：对过去作肯定推测用 must have been + 过去分词，不可用 must be；must be mad 里的 must 是“肯定”，不是“必须”。

exercises.q: 汉译英：飞机正在逐渐把我逼疯。
exercises.a: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
exercises.note: drive sb mad 使某人发疯。

exercises.q: 填空：The airport was built years ago, but for some ______ it could not be used then.
exercises.note: some 表“某种”，后接单数名词。

exercises.q: 句型转换：改为被动语态。They built the airport years ago.
exercises.a: The airport was built years ago.
exercises.note: 一般过去时被动：was + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这条路是上个月开始使用的。
exercises.a: The road came into use last month.
exercises.note: come into use 开始被使用。

exercises.q: 填空：Passing planes can ______ (hear) night and day.
exercises.note: 情态动词被动：can be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 改错：Over a hundred people must be driven away from their homes by the noise.
exercises.a: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
exercises.note: 对过去推测用 must have been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他们曾向我提供一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决心留在这儿。
exercises.a: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here.
exercises.note: be determined to 后接动词原形。

quiz.q: “过往飞机日夜不绝于耳”的正确英文是？
options: Passing planes can be heard night and day.
Passing planes can hear night and day.
Passing planes must hear night and day.
Passing planes are hearing night and day.
quiz.note: 情态动词被动：can be + 过去分词。

quiz.q: “由于某种原因”的正确表达是？
options: for some reason
for some reasons
for a some reason
in some reason
quiz.note: some 表“某种”，后接单数名词。

quiz.q: “机场去年开始使用了”的正确表达是？
options: The airport came into use last year.
The airport came to use last year.
The airport went to use last year.
The airport came into using last year.
quiz.note: come into use 为固定短语。

quiz.q: “一百多人肯定是被噪音逼得弃家远去”的正确表达是？
options: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
Over a hundred people must be driven away from their homes by the noise.
Over a hundred people must driven away from their homes by the noise.
Over a hundred people must have driven away from their homes by the noise.
quiz.note: 对过去推测：must have been + 过去分词。

quiz.q: “有人向我提供了一大笔钱”的正确表达是？
options: I have been offered a large sum of money.
I have offered a large sum of money.
I am offering a large sum of money.
I had offered a large sum of money.
quiz.note: offer sb sth 的被动：sb be offered sth。

quiz.q: “大家都说我肯定是疯了”在课文中的表达是？
options: Everybody says I must be mad.
Everybody says I may be mad.
Everybody says I must to be mad.
Everybody says I must being mad.
quiz.note: must + 动词原形表肯定推测。
